Single photo, no label visible. Viennese bentwood style c.1900-1920; Thonet or Kohn attribution unproven and many similar tables were made by Czech and Polish firms (Fischel, Mundus, Ton, Radomsko).
chrome_hint: eBay sold items: 'bentwood two tier table leather top' and 'Thonet Kohn bentwood round table' (Australia and UK); also invaluable.com 'Thonet bentwood occasional table'

title: EASTERN CARVED CHEST - 1 PANEL DETACHED
identification: Korean style bandaji (blanket chest) with brass mounts: bat/butterfly escutcheon plate, diamond studs, hasp, two hinged top panels over a central lock plate, on a low base. Raw timber interior, dark stained exterior, one top panel detached. Looks 20th century (mid century or later), probably a decorator or reproduction piece, not a 19th century chest. Photos show well-made mounts and a plinth base but no maker marks.
chrome_hint: eBay Australia, sold and completed items: Korean chest brass bandaji OR 'Korean blanket chest' OR 'Korean brass bound chest'. Also Invaluable/LiveAuctioneers past results: Korean bandaji chest brass.

title: FRAMED OIL PAINTING BY ARTHUR PHILLIPS - ABANDONED FARM
identification: Oil on board/canvas of a child in a red shirt before an abandoned sandstone farm building with dried hemlock/umbellifer stalks, signed ARTHUR PHILLIPS 71 lower right (1971), ornate gilt frame. Artist not identified; no Tasmanian or Australian Arthur Phillips of note found in local data. Likely a competent amateur or minor semi-professional work.
chrome_hint: Invaluable/LiveAuctioneers: 'Arthur Phillips' oil painting 1971; also AskArt and Trove for 'Arthur Phillips' artist Tasmania/Australia; eBay sold 'Arthur Phillips oil painting'

title: J SKERRATT ARTWORK - BLOWING BUBBLES
identification: Framed original-looking watercolour of fairies/elves blowing bubbles on a lakeshore under big trees, signed lower right J Skerratt. Single photo, no size given. Style follows Outhwaite/Rentoul but the artist is unknown to me and no records were found. Could be a hobbyist or a modern decorative painter; a print is not ruled out from one photo.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings: 'J Skerratt fairy watercolour'; also Google Images/Artprice/invaluable.com search 'Skerratt fairies' and 'Skerratt watercolour Tasmania'
